_about: Members' stories (SF2.1). Each adventurer's arc is a list of beats. A beat is ready when they have finished 'after_jobs' jobs, their spirits are at least 4, and any building in 'needs' stands. They ask for a word ('!' over their head); you talk to them, hear 'lines', and choose. Each option: 'text' (what you say), 'lines' (what follows), 'morale' (change), 'coins' (change, optional), 'trait' (kept for good, optional). Traits: steady (+5% on every job), bold (takes jobs a step harder), mapper (+10% reward on their jobs), healer (rests twice as fast). Words players see follow docs/CREATIVE.md 'Writing for players'.

lines: Aki
Guildmaster. Can I ask you something? My sister's a captain of the guard in Harrowgate.
Aki
When I left, she said I'd be back within the month with my tail between my legs. I keep thinking about it on the road.
Aki
Should I go after the hard jobs? Show her?

options.text: Prove her wrong, but come home every time.
lines: Aki
Every time. Right. Slow and sure, then. She hates it when I'm careful; that'll annoy her more.

options.text: You don't owe her anything. Go where you want.
lines: Aki
Where I want. Ha! Then I want the barrow. Not today. Soon.
Aki
A letter came with the carter. My sister's riding through Starfall on her way north. Tomorrow.
Aki
I don't know what to say to her. What if she laughs at the place?

options.text: Bring her to the inn. Bryn will feed you both.
lines: That evening, two swordsmen argue cheerfully over Bryn's stew until the lanterns are low.
Aki
She said the town has good bones. From her, that's a parade.

options.text: This is yours to handle. You'll know what to say.
lines: Aki
...Yeah. Yeah, I will. Thanks for not making it a thing, guildmaster.
Ren
I froze out there. The spell just... wasn't there. Aki had to drag me back behind the wagon.
Ren
Maybe I'm not made for this. Maybe I should go back to copying books.

options.text: Everyone freezes once. Come back out tomorrow.
lines: Ren
Tomorrow. All right. I'll practise the opening words until I can say them asleep.

options.text: Take a few days. The board will still be here.
lines: Ren
A few days. I'd like that. I'll read, and walk, and come back when my hands stop shaking.
Ren
Look at this. An old survey map, from a peddler's cart. The roads past the gate, the creeks, the quarry.
Ren
Half of it's wrong now. If I had twenty coins for ink and good paper, I could chart it properly. Every job would go quicker.
Ren
Thank you! I'll have the creek road by the end of the week. You'll see.

options.text: The guild can't spare it right now.
lines: Ren
No, of course. I'll do what I can with charcoal.
Yuna
Guildmaster, I gave my share of the boar job to the farmer's family. Their winter stores are thin.
Yuna
Could the guild give something too? Even a little?

options.text: Give them fifteen coins from the guild.
lines: Yuna
Thank you. They'll remember who helped. So will I.

options.text: The guild needs every coin to keep going.
lines: Yuna
I understand. I don't like it, but I understand.
Yuna
Ama has been letting me watch her work. She knows things about mending that no temple ever taught me.
Yuna
She's offered to teach me properly, in the evenings. I'd be tired for a while.
Yuna
I will. And I'll teach the others how to rest. Ama says we're all terrible at it.

options.text: Your jobs come first for now.
lines: Yuna
All right. Maybe in the spring.
